findings.title: include_website_name missing question mark
findings.body: Method is named `include_website_name` instead of `include_website_name?`. Active Model Serializers' `include_<attr>?` convention requires the trailing question mark to be recognized; without it, this method is never called and `website_name` will likely always be serialized (or behave inconsistently), unlike `website` which uses `untrusted_attributes` for conditional inclusion. This can leak website_name for untrusted/TL0 users even though `website` itself is hidden, defeating the privacy guard in `untrusted_attributes`.

findings.title: Fragile domain parent/child matching logic
findings.body: The branch comparing `website_host.split('.').length == discourse_host.split('.').length` to detect sibling subdomains (e.g. www.example.com vs forum.example.com) is brittle: it only matches when both hosts have the same number of labels and more than 2 labels on the host side, and does not handle multi-level TLDs (e.g. co.uk) or mismatched label counts for legitimate sibling domains, potentially producing incorrect short names or exposing full paths unintentionally.

findings.title: Missing test for include_website_name behavior
findings.body: No test verifies that `website_name` is excluded for untrusted/TL0 users (via `include_website_name?`), unlike other untrusted attributes like `website`. Given the suspected missing `?` bug in the include method, this test gap means the regression would not be caught.
